definition: A desired learning or activity outcome
inclusion_rule: Code when the speaker states what the activity or feedback should accomplish
exclusion_rule: Do not code a proposed procedure unless the intended outcome is also stated
positive_example: The activity should help students explain their reasoning

definition: Observed information used to characterize the current situation or judge a proposal
inclusion_rule: Code references to student work behavior records or an explicit basis for a judgment
exclusion_rule: Do not code unsupported predictions or general preferences
positive_example: Several exit tickets only state the answer

definition: A proposed action tool prompt routine or design response
inclusion_rule: Code a concrete way to pursue the goal or address the evidence
exclusion_rule: Do not code a problem description without a proposed response
positive_example: We could add a prompt for justification

definition: A constraint tension risk or competing value attached to a strategy
inclusion_rule: Code when the speaker identifies a cost limitation or downside that shapes a decision
exclusion_rule: Do not code simple disagreement without a named constraint
positive_example: That prompt may take more class time

definition: A decision to change test or refine the current design
inclusion_rule: Code an explicit commitment to modify or reevaluate a proposal
exclusion_rule: Do not code a new idea that is not framed as a change to the current design
positive_example: Let us revise the prompt and test it
